name: Salt, table (sodium chloride)
note: Na = 22.99/58.44 of NaCl. Iodised and rock/black salts are also mostly NaCl (ICMR-NIN DGI 2024, guideline 11).

name: Sugar, white (sucrose)
derivation: derived:100 g available carbohydrate x 17 kJ/g (IFCT energy factor)

name: Water, drinking
note: Sodium and minerals vary by source (RO, tap, borewell); counted as zero.

name: Rice flour (proxy)
note: Not in IFCT 2017. Values copied from raw milled rice. Replace with analysed value when available.

name: Curd, cow milk (proxy)
note: Not in IFCT 2017. Values copied from whole cow milk. Curd differs in lactose and sometimes in fat; replace with analysed value.

name: Buttermilk, thin (proxy, 1 part curd : 1 part water)
derivation: proxy:half the values of IFCT L002 whole cow milk
note: Not in IFCT 2017. Dilution assumed 1:1; salt added separately. Replace with analysed value.
